notes.title: Take the mic!
notes.notes:
This update brings many new features to the game. Here are some of the biggest ones:

-You might notice medias trying to... Interview you! Yes, they're in! But beware, a bad response can lead to bad consequences...
-Players always had different personnalities, but now they also have traits! That 2B MVP will look even cooler once you learn he's both a poet AND a badass guitarist.
-The AI is now smarter than ever with contracts, with a rebuilding mode and different economics profiles!
-Some improvements for Dargor, your favorite rival of all!
-HOF critera are easier.

notes.title: The International Update
notes.notes:
A new update is available for Astonishing Baseball 20!
It brings you the International Scouting feature. For those of you not familiar with the mobile version, it allows you to send scouts all around the world to find the best prospects!

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37562846/5df936c0e81f4b77ad84f99b986920f02e9a39f8.jpg[/img]

Check out the report on this great French pitcher from Paris, or ask your scout in Asia to spend a bit more time on that DH from Tokyo! And once per season, at the beginning of spring training, you'll be able to pick one of these prospects, who will join the team on a free 1-year contract. Sounds good, right?

This version also brings a lot of small improvements, like Spring Training Projections, a smarter AI, new content for your rival Dargor, and more! Finally, I have added a bunch of bug fixes to make the game even  more stable for you all!

As always, enjoy the game, and please feel free to share some feedback with me over Steam, [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/AstonishingSports/]Reddit[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/LegendsManager]Twitter[/url], or even better, our [url=https://discord.astonishing-sports.app/]Discord [/url]server.

Aerilys

notes.title: Help is on the way!
notes.notes:
A new update for Astonishing Baseball 20 is available! 

The first new feature is an updated help page, easily accessible from the game itself. It contains some useful advices and details about some parts of the game. It also includes a list of keyboard shortcuts that you can use to quickly navigate.

I've also added a button which allows you to directly screenshot a game result page. This should make sharing your glorious games even easier!

More is coming, but if you have ideas or suggestions for future updates, just let me know. You can write to me on the Steam community, on Discord ([url=https://discord.astonishing-sports.app]https://discord.astonishing-sports.app[/url]) or even by email.

Enjoy baseball, and the game!

notes.title: We're live!
notes.notes:
After a long development and plenty of help from the community, Astonishing Baseball 20 is finally live on Steam! We hope you'll love the game as much as we do, and rest assured that there's more to come! 

Meanwhile, enjoy baseball, and remember, you're already an astonishing coach!
